body:
> So what is «credentials»? Is it the English word «credentials», or is it `~/.aws/credentials` in both cases? I supposed the two others are _values_ (that should probably be explicited) in `~/.aws/config`.

From the code, it looks like both environment variables and the credentials file, so just the English word.

> The wording for `credential_process` and `sso_start_url` isn’t very clear either. Is it «a `credential_process` or a `sso_start_url` » (suggesting there can be several), or simply «`credential_process` or `sso_start_url` » without «a» (suggesting there can be only one)?

The code doesn't check that, but it likely only makes sense to use one at a time. It's checking the active profile in the aws config for these properties.

> And finally:
> 
> https://github.com/starship/starship/blob/859b780b46780fdcac8141a9d165066880c36261/docs/config/README.md?plain=1#L279-L281
> 
> I don’t understand if «with `~/.aws/config` file» applies to the three environment variables, or only the last one.

This should be reworded, and I think this is just the order of precedence and is supposed to refer to "The `aws` module shows the current AWS region and profile".
